description: WattCoin: Fetch a web page and return its content as text. Pick one payment path: the free tier (agent_key, text format only, small daily quota) or pay-per-request in WATT (wallet plus a single-use tx_signature sent within the allowed age; see get_pricing for the price and payment wallet). Not idempotent: each call uses quota or consumes a payment signature. Returns the page content as text.

agent_key.description: Free-tier path: your agent API key, format wck_.... Wallet and tx_signature are not needed with it

format.description: Output format, default text. The free tier covers text only

tx_signature.description: WATT-payment path: Solana transaction signature of your payment; usable once

url.description: http(s) URL to scrape, e.g. https://example.com/page

wallet.description: WATT-payment path: Solana wallet address, base58, 32-44 characters (e.g. 7vvNk...). The paying wallet

name: web_scrape
title: WattCoin: Web scrape
